purpose: Complete convergence ledger for gameplay/evaluator mechanics proposed in the Gemini/Antigravity Slack stream. Every proposition terminates in one current canonical V4 disposition; this ledger grants no runtime activation authority.
convergence_rules: A merged or closed PR is ancestry, not canonical evidence. canonical_evidence must resolve to regular non-symlink files under the current candidates/v4 tree.
FALSIFIED literal claims stay recorded and require do_not_repeat_without_new_evidence=true.
FIELD_BLOCKED mechanics remain represented, require do_not_repeat_without_new_evidence=true, and cannot be presented as activation-ready.
CORRECTED_DESCENDANT preserves the useful source mechanism while explicitly replacing a harmful or mechanically false literal policy.
No entry in this ledger changes runtime, defaults, config, COMPOSITION, archive, evaluator, provider, or Kaggle state.

entries.literal_claim: Skip WATER on established ongoing crops because one missed day does not immediately weed the plant.
entries.best_form: Do not rewrite a final WATER to PASS. A successor must spend the slot on productive work, carry a durable next-day recovery-WATER obligation, preserve fertilized production boundaries, and prevent a second consecutive miss.
entries.next_gate: Reopen only with scheduler-level productive substitution, guaranteed recovery WATER, both-seat current-native execution, and no new WEED conversions before economics.

entries.literal_claim: Apex detects recognizable early openings and changes its dump schedule, so blindly cloning its visible line is exploitable.
entries.best_form: Keep the authenticated Apex clone latch as opponent-conditioned evidence only. Use exact opponent identity and public state; never generalize it into a hidden-opponent oracle.
entries.next_gate: Only a current-native opponent-conditioned policy with exact Apex custody, OFF identity, both-seat engagement, and multi-opponent nonregression may consume the latch.

entries.literal_claim: Front-run Apex's known market dumps and buy its dumped fertilizer immediately afterward.
entries.best_form: Retain the authenticated Strawberry timing edge only under exact opponent/public-state custody. Reject the exaggerated FERT sponge: authenticated Apex adds too little FERT for the claimed massive discount.
entries.next_gate: Field the Strawberry-only conditioner against authenticated Apex in both seats plus non-Apex holdouts; require positive paired margin without new-loss strata.

entries.literal_claim: Static per-product demand velocity can predict future scarcity and dictate production targets.
entries.best_form: Use the source-bound passive market/town baseline and actual unlocked-shop multiset. Demand velocity is state- and RNG-dependent; player/rival supply must stay separate from NPC demand.
entries.next_gate: Feed dynamic demand features into an existing production/sale owner and prove incremental held-out predictive value before policy thresholds change.

entries.literal_claim: Use a dynamic price floor to front-run known opponent dumps rather than waiting for static sale checkpoints.
entries.best_form: Compute marginal timing from public inventory, deterministic town/shop drains, exact opponent custody, row alignment, and downstream obligations; do not hard-code one opponent's timestamps.
entries.next_gate: Compose with incumbent seller/market owners and require exact returned-action engagement plus both-seat economics without downstream-deferral regressions.

entries.literal_claim: EGG's logarithmic curve gives an effectively infinite scarcity/oversupply singularity and supports a direct short squeeze.
entries.best_form: EGG is unusually price-resilient but finite. Direct EGG BUY_PRODUCT is impossible; use source-bound elasticity and town-demand drains only for production/sale valuation.
entries.next_gate: Test goose/EGG production or sale policies against current-native economics; no direct squeeze branch without an engine change.

entries.literal_claim: Unlocking land can be strategically harmful because newly empty cells increase weed exposure.
entries.best_form: Model expansion as added weed exposure plus route/service cost and the shared-RNG cursor externality that can change later shop unlocks. Expansion is allowed only when productive ROI dominates those measured costs.
entries.next_gate: Score marginal land through the existing opening/land owner with service-capacity and RNG-neutralized holdouts before changing acquisition timing.

entries.literal_claim: Sell FERTILIZER at the $1 floor as recoverable off-site storage and buy it back later with effectively infinite capacity.
entries.best_form: The literal warehouse is false: floor SELL destroys shed custody instead of adding public inventory. The surviving form is bounded paid shed-FERT disposal only when projected EOD overflow makes capacity relief worth more.
entries.next_gate: Only current-native overflow engagement plus paired both-seat economics may promote B7 disposal; never recreate a buyback warehouse.

entries.literal_claim: Buy ten geese on day zero, exploit early fertilizer readiness, and print cash before egg production.
entries.best_form: The fertilizer-ready timing edge is real, but ten no-hire geese cannot be placed before EOD0. The certified frontier is nine geese plus one $1 HIRE; it is an opening frontier, not a cash-printer theorem.
entries.next_gate: Evaluate smaller and nine-goose openings through the existing opener/native assembler against current opponents in both seats before runtime admission.

entries.literal_claim: Feed animals every other day to halve WHEAT use without losing output.
entries.best_form: A first missed feed can preserve base output when CARE is disabled and a second consecutive miss is forbidden. Blanket alternation destroys CARE-enhanced value; any live form must be CARE-aware, storage-aware, and guarantee the next feed.
entries.next_gate: Require current composed-V4 reachability, sticky next-feed timing, CARE-value safety, both-seat economics, and no escape/storage regressions.

entries.literal_claim: Use worker-carried inventory as uncapped intraday storage to bypass the 100-unit shed cap.
entries.best_form: Carried inventory is a real temporary custody surface, but the acquisition-aware current-route census found no safe raw-route admissions after future PICKUP/COLLECT obligations and lossy DROP/EOD are honored.
entries.next_gate: Reopen only with a sticky-obligation scheduler witness that preserves future acquisitions, proves safe liquidation/deposit, and changes returned actions beneficially.

entries.literal_claim: Because MELON has no ordinary town-center demand, cap total MELON production with a hard lifetime counter.
entries.best_form: The crude sold-only cap is harmful. The repaired default-off source component authenticates complete executable MELON PLANT cardinality and exact first-day land/seed/hire suffix custody for each whole proposal, while evaluating mutually exclusive route alternatives independently rather than decrementing one shared budget.
entries.next_gate: Gate current-native composition on natural both-seat engagement, then require positive paired economics without new-loss strata before activation.

entries.literal_claim: Simulate no-action market/town evolution to expose pure NPC demand and price drift.
entries.best_form: Keep the source-bound passive town/market oracle as a forecasting baseline only. It must model weed RNG consumption before shop unlock RNG and must not be confused with gameplay policy or rival-supply forecast.
entries.next_gate: Use it as a control feature in demand/timing experiments; gameplay changes still require full-interpreter current-native evidence.

entries.literal_claim: Represented futures that omit per-turn plant decay can invent harvestable crop inventory and corrupt funding/sale decisions.
entries.best_form: Advance official plant decay at the correct represented-turn stage before later unit actions. Keep narrow pre-decay harvest opportunities separate and require cargo/deposit/sale realization before assigning value.
entries.next_gate: Any decay-derived action must pass current-postimage execution, cargo custody, terminal realization, and both-seat economic gates.

entries.literal_claim: A freshly planted crop near EOD can die immediately if the route cannot WATER it before refresh.
entries.best_form: Treat PLANT plus same-EOD WATER as the establishment budget for new crops. Use crop-service capacity as an admission/impossibility bound, not a simplistic time cutoff.
entries.next_gate: Consume the bound inside the existing crop scheduler and prove it prevents doomed planting without suppressing feasible profitable placements.

entries.literal_claim: Changing empty-tile occupancy changes how many shared RNG draws weeds consume before shop selection, allowing policy actions to shift later shop RNG.
entries.best_form: Keep the exact shared-stream occupancy-to-shop coupling as a source theorem. Treat it as controlled RNG steering with explicit action/economic cost, not hidden-seed clairvoyance or blanket structure carpet.
entries.next_gate: Find productive primary actions that also yield favorable robust RNG shifts; require seed-distribution holdouts and no action-EV loss.

entries.literal_claim: The first visible weed pattern is enough to recover the hidden episode seed and predict the future RNG stream.
entries.best_form: Opening weed observations constrain a seed domain but are highly non-unique. Do not infer a unique hidden seed without independent leakage or exhaustive authenticated complete-domain uniqueness.
entries.next_gate: None on the current engine without new independent seed information or authenticated exhaustive uniqueness.

entries.literal_claim: If aggregate same-crop PLANT demand exceeds held seeds, the official atomic preflight can turn every same-crop PLANT into PASS.
entries.best_form: Preserve the real atomic admission theorem. SEEDGHOST removes only provably non-existent suffix-actor PLANT rows that poison live demand; genuine live oversubscription remains blocked.
entries.next_gate: Reopen runtime composition only when a current postimage emits an output-changing poisoned form, then require exact-engine both-seat economics.

entries.literal_claim: Directly BUY_PRODUCT TOMATO, EGG or CARROT into carried storage to create artificial scarcity and squeeze the opponent.
entries.best_form: The direct squeeze is engine-invalid because BUY_PRODUCT accepts only WHEAT and FERTILIZER. Non-buyables can only be influenced through production, sales, and town demand.
entries.next_gate: Reopen only if an authenticated engine changes BUY_PRODUCT eligibility.

entries.literal_claim: Pre-build zero-cash structures on empty tiles to bank future weed-clearing actions and reduce RNG exposure.
entries.best_form: Cash-free structures are not action-free. Blanket prebuilding is expected-action dominated; build only when independently productive, and treat any weed/RNG benefit as secondary and measured.
entries.next_gate: A successor must show productive structure need plus net action savings and robust whole-game economics; no carpet-only policy.

entries.literal_claim: Because BUILD_COOP and BUILD_PASTURE deduct no cash, blanket empty land with structures to suppress weeds at negligible cost.
entries.best_form: The zero-cash branch is real, but action/opportunity cost is not zero. Structures belong to real livestock/route demand; weed suppression and RNG steering are explicit side effects, not blanket-carpet justification.
entries.next_gate: Only a productive structure placement that already pays its unit-action/route cost may consume the weed/RNG side benefit.
